name: Passos no Escuro - The Baby
description: Cinema Passos Manuel screens The Baby as part of the Passos no Escuro film cycle on 16 December 2026.
longDescription:
Passos no Escuro presents a screening of The Baby at Cinema Passos Manuel on 16 December 2026. The session begins at 22:00 and runs for 120 minutes.

Tickets cost 7€, with discounts available for Tripass holders. The event is rated for viewers over 18 years old and is promoted by Jardim das Coincidências Lda.
